body:
Das Haus / die zweistöckige Wohnung ist Teil eines wunderschönen, ruhig gelegenen alten Landguts mit 2 weiteren Ferienwohnungen.

Das Besondere – wie die Fotos zeigen – ist, wie edel und stilvoll das Haus renoviert wurde und auch wie funktional und geschmackvoll es eingerichtet ist. Wohltuend ist das Fehlen von überflüssigem Plüsch und unnötiger Dekoration.

Wir waren von der Unterkunft begeistert und konnten uns keine schönere Bleibe vorstellen.

Der nächste Ort Balestrate ist ca. 3 km entfernt und bietet alle notwendigen Einkaufsmöglichkeiten.

Besonders erwähnenswert ist zudem, dass Elena, die Vermieterin, immer sofort online erreichbar war und uns mit Tipps versorgen konnte.

body: We had a fantastic time at this old converted farmyard. This is a beautiful old place and it’s getting renovated unit by unit. It was cool to see the difference between old and new. The decoration is very tasteful in a minimalist sort of way. The bathroom is lovely and comfortable. Elena, the owner, was not there herself but we kept in close phone and WhatsApp contact and she was amazing – and speaks fluent German. Her tips for sights and restaurants were also great. There are three cute cats who became our friends along with pig Giuseppina who lives outside the place in a lemon tree garden (you don’t see or smell her unless you look for her) and who loved our veggie peels. The location is an ideal starting place for exploring the west of Sicily. But you do need a car. The island was still very quiet and not very touristy at that time of year. We’ll be back.

body: Elena was the perfect host with regular communication, before, during and after our lovely week in Sicily. Elena made every effort to make our stay the best it could be, providing us with information and recommendations about local places to visit and even some that were further afield. On arrival we were met with a bottle of wine, some local baked goods and a friendly face to welcome us to the accommodation and show us around. The apartment was beautifully presented and very clean, it felt like we were the first people to stay there. The area itself was perfect for us, we were situated just outside of Balastrate in a lovely quiet little court yard, shared by others. A small into town or to the beech was necessary but this never caused us a problem and we actually liked being slightly out of town in our peaceful getaway. The apartment felt modern but authentically Italian and was a great find for myself and my three other travelling friends. A definite recommendation from us!

body: Our stay at Elena’s Baglio was simply fantastic. The house is quiet and peaceful, the area is very safe and the location is perfect for seeing Palermo, riserva dello Zingaro, Trapani and other close-by locations. The house was as described in the listing. It was very clean and had all the necessary to ensure a comfortable stay. The location is perfect for groups of friends or families travelling together in big groups as there are a total of 4 apartments for rent in the same baglio. This one is the smallest of the 4, I believe. Elena, the host, was very friendly and ensured everything went well despite not being there in person. She gave good tips on restaurants and sites to visit! I will definitely recommend this to anyone travelling around beautiful Sicily!

body: We arrived at this Air BnB after staying in three others in the weeks leading up. It was as described in every way. Having just left an amazing but very urban location in Siracusa – we found the rural setting very charming. The bedroom windows open on to an olive orchard… from time to time we spied people on horseback passing by as we sat on the terrace. The entire complex is a sort of farmstead (or was) which is clearly being carefully renovated for this new use. The owners have made what I can only assume are significant investments in the infrastructure (water service, electrical) and I would assume they will continue to make improvements to the parts of the building not yet in use. Unlike an apartment – here you are sharing the premises with other travelers. Which was nice. There is the communal courtyard while the unit itself is very private. Would be a great location for a large group wanting to all be together but also have their own spaces. The unit itself felt as if we were the first visitors (which is always nice). Clean and well cared for. It was insanely spacious. We loved the roof terrace and used it many mornings and evenings – coffee, cocktails, conversations and sketching. If you have traveled a lot you may appreciate the following. The shower. It was incredible. Water pressure and space unlike anything we have had access to in a month of travel. It was a joy. The kitchen is not large but was equipped with everything we needed and more. The overall feel of the place was great. Rural but not isolated. Traditional architecture but contemporary furnishings. Rustic in some ways but refined in the ways that mattered. Finally was the location. We thought it was really ideal. Balestrate is quite humble. We went to the grocery there. Got coffee and pastry one morning. Dinner one night. Gas. But from our exploration it was nothing remarkable. That said – 12 minutes farther away is Castellemare Del Golfo which is very charming and has quite a bit to offer both in scenery and dining. The house is also ideally located for visits to Palermo, Erice, San Vito de Capo, Segesta and Scopello – all of which we did in a five night stay. Life hack. For our trip to Palmermo we drove to the airport (west side which is where you’ll be approaching from) and parked. Then we took a bus into the center of the city. It was insanely easy and nice to let someone else deal with the traffic. Best dining options we found were in Castellemare Del Golfo. Both on and off the beaten path. Between tips from our host and Trip Advsior we found lots of good choices. We would have skipped San Vito di Capo if we had it to do again. All in all a great stay and would highly recommend this apartment.

body:
What a special place.

Elena has created a little piece of paradise in the landscape of Sicily. Everything about our stay was absolutely perfect! Elena’s property has been immaculately and lovingly rebuilt. Her attention to detail is apparent everywhere you look, from the amazing kitchen sink to the beautiful Sicilian tiles, the comfortable furnishings, the lovely terrace, and the lush gardens surrounding the house. The kitchen was well stocked. The bedrooms are spacious and very comfortable, with a floor level shower. There are sun loungers at your disposal if you enjoy just laying at the patio there with a glass of wine. We had every intention to explore the area, but we soon found ourselves so relaxed and happy at the terrace that we didn’t range very far. The physical beauty of Elena’s home is lovely and well worth a visit (or two!), but what makes it truly exceptional is the host herself. Elena is so warm and inviting, and helpful in any possible way, she made us feel genuinely welcome and comfortable in their home. We fell in love with the place, not only because of its exceptional location, but because its owners have imbued it with their own sense of beauty and their great generosity. It is luxurious and simple all at once, providing great comfort and utter beauty. I could go on, but really – the place is extraordinary, and our stay was perfect, except for one major flaw: it ended. Overall i would highly recommend Elena’s place as a perfect base for a holiday in Sicily and we will definitely be staying here again on our next visit.
